game.name: Install Decky Loader
game.desc: Installs the official Decky Loader plugin system for Steam (Big Picture) — the latest stable release fetched straight from SteamDeckHomebrew — plus a watcher that re-injects the Decky menu when Steam launches so it keeps working across nightly updates. Re-run any time to repair or reinstall. Requires Steam.

game.name: Update Decky Loader
game.desc: Updates Decky Loader to the latest official stable release. Reliable on this device (unlike Decky's in-app updater) and a no-op if you are already current. Keeps the previous build for rollback; your plugins and settings are preserved.

game.name: Rollback Decky Loader
game.desc: Reverts Decky Loader to the previously installed version (kept by the last update) and restarts the plugin service.

game.name: Uninstall Decky Loader
game.desc: Removes Decky Loader: stops and disables the plugin service, removes the boot watcher and the homebrew tree (loader, plugins and settings).
